_readme: The English text of every player-facing content field, by stable key: the single source of English. The content data files hold these keys (the fields and the key scheme are in src/BeastCraft.Core/Localization/ContentTextRules.cs); the game resolves them as it loads the content. Edit text here. To add content, write the English into the data file as usual and run `dotnet run --project Tooling/ContentKeys`: it moves the new text here and puts its key in the data file. Keys never change once shipped. ui.* keys are the screens' own text. Other locales go beside this file as <locale>.json with the same keys (languages are decided after launch).

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_coat_t3_rare.name: Outrider Coat

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_coat_t4.name: Silversteel Coat

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t1.name: Bramble Ring

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t1_rare.name: Wayfarer Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t2.desc: A copper ring that tingles before trouble: more Speed and more critical hits.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t2.name: Copper Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t2_rare.desc: A pathfinder's compass ring that always points at trouble: more Speed and crits.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t2_rare.name: Pathfinder Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t3.desc: A plain iron band, cold and sure: quicker commands and keener strikes.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t3.name: Ironbound Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t3_rare.desc: An outrider's signet: the Beastbinder moves first and spots every opening.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t3_rare.name: Outrider Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t4.desc: A silversteel ring that hums when danger is near: a quick step and a sharp eye.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t4.name: Silversteel Ring
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t4_rare.desc: A ring with a spark trapped inside: lightning-quick and sharp-eyed.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t4_rare.name: Stormcaller Ring

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t5_rare.desc: A ring set with a sliver of star: the quickest, keenest ring on sale.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_ring_t5_rare.name: Starbound Ring

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t1.name: Bramble Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t1_rare.desc: A wayfarer's staff notched with every mile walked: skills and heals hit harder.

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t2_rare.name: Pathfinder Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t3.desc: An iron-shod staff carved with binding runes: stronger skills and heals.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t3.name: Ironbound Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t3_rare.desc: An outrider's rune-staff, heavy with old oaths: skills and heals strike true.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t3_rare.name: Outrider Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t4.desc: A slender silversteel staff that rings with power: skills and heals land with force.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t4.name: Silversteel Staff

Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t4_rare.name: Stormcaller Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t5.desc: A sunmetal staff crowned with a glowing sun-knot: skills and heals shine brightest.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t5.name: Sunmetal Staff
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t5_rare.desc: A staff tipped with a captured star: the finest a Trader sells for skills and heals.
Strings.avatar_gear.avatar_staff_t5_rare.name: Starbound Staff
Strings.bond.bedrock.desc: Stone and iron, layered: when an ally drops below 60% health, the healthiest Earth or Metal beast draws every enemy near it onto itself for three turns (once per ally per battle).
Strings.bond.bedrock.name: Bedrock
Strings.bond.combined_arms.desc: A team fielding all three stances fights on when one falls: each time an ally is defeated, the rest hit harder, physical and special alike, for three turns (twice per battle).
Strings.bond.combined_arms.name: Combined Arms
Strings.bond.crossfire.desc: Ranged beasts cover each other's angles: when an enemy's single-target attack hits a Ranged beast, another Ranged beast within range of the attacker may return fire.
Strings.bond.crossfire.name: Crossfire
Strings.bond.guardian.desc: Vanguards cover the beasts behind them: when an enemy's single-target attack is aimed at a non-Vanguard ally within two hexes, the healthiest Vanguard may step in, bracing behind a shield, and take the blow instead.
Strings.bond.guardian.name: Guardian
Strings.bond.pack_hunters.desc: Skirmishers hunt as a pack: each gains critical-hit chance, and when an ally lands a critical hit, a Skirmisher within reach piles onto the same target.
Strings.bond.pack_hunters.name: Pack Hunters
Strings.bond.storm_front.desc: Thunder over the deep: when a Lightning or Water beast fielded with the other lands a critical hit, the target may be stunned for a turn.
Strings.bond.storm_front.name: Storm Front
Strings.bond.twilight.desc: Light and Dark in balance: when an ally starts its turn stunned or burning, a Light or Dark beast clears it and mends it so the ally can act (three times per beast per battle).
Strings.bond.twilight.name: Twilight
Strings.bond.wildfire.desc: Wind feeds the flame: when a Fire or Air beast fielded with the other lands a hit, the target may catch fire and burn for two turns.
Strings.bond.wildfire.name: Wildfire
Strings.bond.winter_grove.desc: Evergreens under rime: when an ally drops below a third of its health, an Ice or Nature beast wraps it in a frost shield and mends it (once per ally per battle).
Strings.bond.winter_grove.name: Winter Grove

Strings.creature.basilisk.desc: A sly serpent-king whose gaze reaches farther than any fang and can turn a foe to stone. It slips through shadow to find the weakest enemy, and cannot afford to be found in turn.
Strings.creature.basilisk.name: Basilisk
Strings.creature.frost_wyrm.desc: An old dragon wrapped in rime, with a dry sense of humour. It never hurries; it simply makes the battlefield colder, slowing and freezing its foes, and waits for the cold to win.
Strings.creature.frost_wyrm.name: Frost Wyrm
Strings.creature.golem.desc: A hillside that learned to stand. Slow and stubborn, it plants itself up front, dares every nearby enemy to strike it and raises walls of granite around its friends. Nothing gets past it.
Strings.creature.golem.name: Golem
Strings.creature.griffin.desc: Half eagle, half lion, all wind. Bold and restless, it is across the field before the enemy has turned, rakes with talons and lances of air, and is gone again before the blow lands.
Strings.creature.griffin.name: Griffin
Strings.creature.kirin.desc: A serene, luminous beast said to walk without bending the grass. It shuns claws and horns and fights with light instead, healing and blessing its team and calling down pillars of radiance.
Strings.creature.kirin.name: Kirin
Strings.creature.leviathan.desc: A calm serpent of the deep whose coils could cradle a ship. Its whirlpools drag enemies to it, and it shields itself in its scales and simply outlasts whatever breaks against it.
Strings.creature.leviathan.name: Leviathan
Strings.creature.phoenix.desc: A proud bird of living flame that burns brightest just before it falls. It strikes hard from afar and sets foes smouldering, and once a battle wraps itself in renewing fire, but it has little to stand behind up close.
Strings.creature.phoenix.name: Phoenix
Strings.creature.tarasque.desc: A grumpy river-beast in a shell of iron plates and spines. Where the Golem only endures, the Tarasque endures and bites back, cracking armour and crushing whatever stands in front of it.
Strings.creature.tarasque.name: Tarasque
Strings.creature.thunderbird.desc: Its wingbeat is the thunder and its dive is the lightning. Nothing acts before it, and it opens every fight with one great dive from the clouds, though it cannot take many hits back.
Strings.creature.thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
Strings.creature.treant.desc: A gentle forest guardian with roots older than kingdoms. It shelters its allies under bark, mends whichever friend is worst off and lashes enemies with thorned vines.
Strings.creature.treant.name: Treant

Strings.encounter.boss_r01_hollow_warden.desc: A moss-backed champion that once guarded the Hollow's Seal for the first Beastbinders and now guards it from everyone. Two horned brutes stamp at its side.
Strings.encounter.boss_r01_hollow_warden.name: Mossjaw the Warden
Strings.encounter.boss_r02_ember_twins.desc: Twin fire champions who fight back to back on the ridge, trading sparks and grudges, while two archers pepper the field from the rocks above.
Strings.encounter.boss_r02_ember_twins.name: Ember Twins
Strings.encounter.boss_r03_tide_colossus.desc: A barnacled water giant risen from the drowned ruins, with two casters chanting tide and frost from the shallows at its feet.
Strings.encounter.boss_r03_tide_colossus.name: Drowned Colossus
Strings.encounter.boss_r04_storm_titan.desc: An air giant who walks the cloud line wrapped in its own gale, while three stalkers slip through the wind to pounce on stragglers.
Strings.encounter.boss_r04_storm_titan.name: Gale Titan
Strings.encounter.boss_r05_rust_knights.desc: Two great antlered champions, one of iron and one of stone, lock horns with anyone who nears the Seal. A shaman and two brutes keep the herd.
Strings.encounter.boss_r05_rust_knights.name: Iron Stags
Strings.encounter.boss_r06_frost_matriarch.desc: A towering ice giant who shelters a skittering brood of ten swarmlings under her skirts of snow, while two archers watch from the drifts.
Strings.encounter.boss_r06_frost_matriarch.name: Frost Matriarch
Strings.encounter.boss_r07_thunder_court.desc: The lightning giant holds court on the highest spire, a gale champion at its right hand and two casters crackling at its back.
Strings.encounter.boss_r07_thunder_court.name: Thunder Court
Strings.encounter.boss_r08_deepwild_heart.desc: The oldest living thing in the Deepwild: a nature giant grown half into the forest, wrapped in a humming cloud of twelve stinglings and tended by two shamans.
Strings.encounter.boss_r08_deepwild_heart.name: Deepwild Heart
Strings.encounter.boss_r09_cinder_king.desc: A fire giant crowned in cooling lava who sits the volcano's throne, flanked by two champions of stone and iron.
Strings.encounter.boss_r09_cinder_king.name: Cinder King
Strings.encounter.boss_r10_apex_pair.desc: Two ancient giants, one of fire and one of water, who have guarded the Worldcrown's summit together since the first Seal was set. Where they meet, the Gloam rises.
Strings.encounter.boss_r10_apex_pair.name: Flame and Flood
Strings.encounter.boss_r11_dusk_and_dawn.desc: Two ancient giants, one of radiant dawn and one of deepest dusk, who keep the endless evening beyond the Worldcrown in balance. They test every bond that comes this far.
Strings.encounter.boss_r11_dusk_and_dawn.name: Dusk and Dawn
Strings.encounter.boss_r11_dusk_and_dawn_hard.de: The twin giants of Duskmeridian with halo and shadow at full blaze: the same pair, fiercer than any creature in the Farwild. Only the boldest Beastbinders ask for this.
Strings.encounter.hg_brookside_rabble.desc: Scamps splash in the mill race while a caster mutters over the water. The mill wheel has stopped turning to listen.
Strings.encounter.hg_brookside_rabble.name: Brookside Rabble
Strings.encounter.hg_gloam_at_the_hedge.desc: At the far hedge the shimmer thickens, and something big comes out of it: a champion of the vale, gloamed and bewildered, with two stinglings in its wake. Calm it, and the way to Verdant Hollow is open.
Strings.encounter.hg_gloam_at_the_hedge.name: The Gloam at the Hedge
Strings.encounter.hg_hedgerow_pests.desc: A buzzing knot of stinglings and a scamp that have made the old hedgerow their own. One of them hums with the green of the meadow.
Strings.encounter.hg_hedgerow_pests.name: Hedgerow Pests
Strings.encounter.hg_meadow_scamps.desc: Two gloam-dazed scamps tumbling through the clover, snapping at anything that moves. They are more lost than fierce.
Strings.encounter.hg_meadow_scamps.name: Meadow Scamps
Strings.encounter.hg_orchard_raiders.desc: A brute shakes the apple trees while an archer and a stingling help themselves to the windfalls. A draught of courage would not go amiss.
Strings.encounter.hg_orchard_raiders.name: Orchard Raiders
Strings.encounter.hg_ridge_prowlers.desc: A stalker slinks along the ridge path with an archer and a pair of scamps. Your whole team, at last, can meet them together.
Strings.encounter.hg_ridge_prowlers.name: Ridge Prowlers
Strings.encounter.hg_trial_bramble.desc: A horned brute stands at the kinship stone, stamping in the brambles. Stand your ground beside your beast and another may choose to join you.
Strings.encounter.hg_trial_bramble.name: Bramble Trial
Strings.encounter.hg_trial_grove.desc: An old shaman keeps the second kinship stone, two scamps at its heels. Show it a team that stands together and a third beast will answer.
Strings.encounter.hg_trial_grove.name: Grove Trial
Strings.encounter.hg_tumbledown_wall.desc: An archer has taken the tumbled stones as a lookout, with a stingling darting between the rocks below.
Strings.encounter.hg_tumbledown_wall.name: Tumbledown Wall
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r01.desc: A mossy champion keeps the kinship stone, a horned brute and a lean stalker at its side. Stand firm and a beast of the Hollow may choose you.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r01.name: Mossbound Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r02.desc: A smouldering champion stands guard at the glowing stone with an archer and a caster behind it. Win and a beast of the ridges may answer.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r02.name: Cinderglow Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r03.desc: A brine-soaked champion rises from the pool by the stone, a shaman and a brute wading after it. Win and a beast of the tides may choose you.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r03.name: Tidewrack Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r04.desc: A gale-wrapped champion swoops down on the still stone with two stalkers circling. Win and a beast of the crags may answer.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r04.name: Galecrest Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r05.desc: A rust-plated champion guards the rooted stone, a brute and an archer beside it. Win and a beast of the iron wood may choose you.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r05.name: Ironroot Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r06_rime.desc: A frost-bright champion keeps the glassy stone with a caster and a stalker. Win and a beast of the frozen lake may answer.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r06_rime.name: Rimeglass Trial
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r06_shade.desc: A dusk-cloaked champion rises from the shadow of the dark stone, a shaman and an archer behind it. Win and the last beast may choose you.
Strings.encounter.kin_trial_r06_shade.name: Deepshade Trial
Strings.encounter_shape.elite.desc: A boss with an escort: one giant and two standard enemies, or two champions (mini-bosses) and one or two standard enemies.
Strings.encounter_shape.elite.name: Elite
Strings.encounter_shape.elite_postgame.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the elite recipe (dens and passes), calibrated harder. Pays out as an elite.
Strings.encounter_shape.elite_postgame.name: Post-game elite
Strings.encounter_shape.elite_postgame_hard.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the elite recipe (dens and passes), calibrated harder still, for Hard. Pays out as an elite.
Strings.encounter_shape.elite_postgame_hard.name: Post-game elite (Hard)
Strings.encounter_shape.horde.desc: Sixteen to twenty-four enemies: mostly swarm (tiny melee: swarmlings bite, physical; stinglings sting, special; one skill each, since every hit deals at least the damage floor), with a few archers and casters behind them.
Strings.encounter_shape.horde.name: Horde
Strings.encounter_shape.horde_postgame.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the horde recipe, calibrated harder. Pays out as a horde.
Strings.encounter_shape.horde_postgame.name: Post-game horde
Strings.encounter_shape.horde_postgame_hard.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the horde recipe, calibrated harder still, for Hard. Pays out as a horde.
Strings.encounter_shape.horde_postgame_hard.name: Post-game horde (Hard)
Strings.encounter_shape.solo.desc: One giant: huge HP, heavy single-target hits in both categories every turn and a periodic area slam in both. Compositions differ only in the giant's element.
Strings.encounter_shape.solo.name: Solo giant
Strings.encounter_shape.squad.desc: Four to six standard enemies of at least three types: melee tanks, hunters, archers, casters and shamans.
Strings.encounter_shape.squad.name: Squad
Strings.encounter_shape.squad_postgame.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the squad recipe, calibrated harder. Pays out as a squad.
Strings.encounter_shape.squad_postgame.name: Post-game squad
Strings.encounter_shape.squad_postgame_hard.desc: Post-game (Duskmeridian, level 100): the squad recipe, calibrated harder still, for Hard. Pays out as a squad.
Strings.encounter_shape.squad_postgame_hard.name: Post-game squad (Hard)
Strings.enemy.archer.desc: Gloamed wild folk who keep to high ground and loose arrows from three hexes away. Frail once caught.
Strings.enemy.archer.name: Archer
Strings.enemy.archer.skill.arrow.desc: An arrow at the nearest foe within three hexes.
Strings.enemy.archer.skill.arrow.name: Arrow Shot
Strings.enemy.brute.desc: A thick-hided, horned creature that plants itself in the way. Blows barely dent it, and it smashes whatever is nearest.
Strings.enemy.brute.name: Brute
Strings.enemy.brute.skill.smash.desc: A heavy blow on the nearest foe.
Strings.enemy.brute.skill.smash.name: Smash
Strings.enemy.caster.desc: A round, two-legged beast with tall antlers. It hangs back and sparks spiteful bolts from the orb between its antlers at the weakest foe, which may leave it burning.
Strings.enemy.caster.name: Caster
Strings.enemy.caster.skill.bolt.desc: A bolt at the foe with the least HP within three hexes; may leave it burning for two turns.
Strings.enemy.caster.skill.bolt.name: Spite Bolt
Strings.enemy.champion.desc: The strongest creature of its pack, swollen with Gloam until it fills three hexes. It cleaves the front line, hexes whichever foe is weakest and sends out shockwaves.
Strings.enemy.champion.name: Champion
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.cleave.desc: A sweeping blow on the nearest foe.
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.cleave.name: Great Cleave
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.hex.desc: A curse on the foe with the least HP within two hexes.
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.hex.name: Gloam Hex
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.shockwave.desc: A burst of force that strikes everything within two hexes.
Strings.enemy.champion.skill.shockwave.name: Shockwave
Strings.enemy.giant.desc: A hill-sized elder of the wild, woken cross by the Gloam. It fills seven hexes, hits hard up close and at range, and every few turns stomps or roars at everything around it.
Strings.enemy.giant.name: Giant
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.crush.desc: A huge fist on the nearest foe.
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.crush.name: Crushing Fist
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.gaze.desc: A searing glare at the nearest foe within two hexes.
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.gaze.name: Baleful Glare
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.quake.desc: Stamps the ground, striking everything adjacent; may stun for a turn.
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.quake.name: Ground Stomp
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.roar.desc: A bellow that batters everything adjacent.
Strings.enemy.giant.skill.roar.name: Dread Roar
Strings.enemy.shaman.desc: A wild-folk elder with a gnarled staff who wades in close and calls squalls down on groups of foes.
Strings.enemy.shaman.name: Shaman
Strings.enemy.shaman.skill.staff.desc: A rap of the gnarled staff on the nearest foe.
Strings.enemy.shaman.skill.staff.name: Staff Rap
Strings.enemy.shaman.skill.storm.desc: Calls a squall down on everything within two hexes.
Strings.enemy.shaman.skill.storm.name: Squall
Strings.enemy.stalker.desc: A lean, antlered hunter that circles wide and pounces on whichever foe has the least HP left.
Strings.enemy.stalker.name: Stalker
Strings.enemy.stalker.skill.shadow_claw.desc: A pouncing strike on the foe with the least HP.
Strings.enemy.stalker.skill.shadow_claw.name: Ambush Claw
Strings.enemy.stingling.desc: A small, owl-like pest of the woods with a glowing barb on its tail. Its sting is small but may leave a lingering poison.
Strings.enemy.stingling.name: Stingling
Strings.enemy.stingling.skill.sting.desc: A sting on the nearest foe; may poison it for two turns.
Strings.enemy.stingling.skill.sting.name: Sting
Strings.enemy.swarmling.desc: A tiny horned critter, round and tufted, that comes by the dozen. Each bite is small; the swarm is not.
Strings.enemy.swarmling.name: Swarmling
Strings.enemy.swarmling.skill.bite.desc: A small bite on the nearest foe.
Strings.enemy.swarmling.skill.bite.name: Bite

Strings.expedition_story.story_far_ridge_trail.t: The trail crests a ridge with a view of country none of the maps quite agree on. The scouts added their own notes.
Ice on the ridge has grown so clear you can see frozen leaves inside it, perfectly preserved from some older autumn.
Strings.expedition_story.story_nearby_meadow.tex: A meadow just past the treeline is thick with wildflowers that close up tight whenever a shadow passes over.
Strings.expedition_story.story_old_orchard.text: The old orchard's trees are gnarled and half-wild now, but they still fruit every year, right on schedule.
Strings.expedition_story.story_quiet_ruins.text: Something was built here once, long enough ago that moss has claimed most of the walls. It still feels cared for.
Strings.expedition_story.story_river_bend.text: Where the river bends there is a quiet pool the current never seems to disturb, however hard it rains upstream.
Strings.expedition_story.story_sunken_shoal.text: At low tide a shoal appears, ringed in shells no one has named yet. The scouts sketched a few before the water returned.
Strings.expedition_story.story_whispering_hollow: The scouts found a hollow tree that hums faintly when the wind turns. They left it exactly as they found it.

Strings.gear.barding_t1.name: Bramble Barding
Strings.gear.barding_t1_rare.desc: Road-scarred but sturdy: a wayfarer's barding that turns claws and adds health.
Strings.gear.barding_t1_rare.name: Wayfarer Barding

Strings.gear.barding_t2.name: Copper Barding
Strings.gear.barding_t2_rare.desc: Layered pathfinder plating built for long treks: solid Defense and extra health.
Strings.gear.barding_t2_rare.name: Pathfinder Barding

Strings.glossary.adaptive_assist.definition: Lose a fight and it eases a little; lose it again and it eases a little more, down to a floor; win it and the ease resets. Rewards and XP never change. It never applies on Hard difficulty in the post-game, or in Hearthglen.
Strings.glossary.atb.definition: Active Time Battle: there are no rounds. Every unit fills its own gauge each tick, faster the higher its Speed, and whoever fills it first acts next. Turns grow with the square root of Speed, so double the Speed is about 1.41 times the turns.
Strings.glossary.aura.definition: A passive that is always on: its effect holds for the whole battle.
Strings.glossary.burn.definition: Fire damage over time: the unit loses a fixed amount of HP at the start of each of its turns while it lasts. Burns can stack.
Strings.glossary.cleanse.definition: Clears every stun, burn and poison from the unit at once. Shields and taunts stay.
Strings.glossary.crit.definition: A critical hit deals one and a half times the damage. Every hit rolls its own chance to crit, from the attacker's crit chance.
Strings.glossary.element_chart.definition: How a skill's element fares against a target's: Strong x2, Mild x1.25, Weak x0.5, anything else x1. A target with two elements takes both multipliers. Open the full chart from the glossary.
Strings.glossary.execute.definition: Extra damage against a worn-down target: the hit grows with the target's missing HP, up to the skill's full bonus at 0 HP. A +100% execute hits one and a half times as hard at half HP.
Strings.glossary.gauge.definition: The turn meter behind the ATB order. It fills by 100 x the square root of Speed each tick, and a turn costs 100,000 points: a Speed 100 unit acts once every 100 ticks. The turn-order bar shows the predicted order and, under each portrait, the ticks until that turn (+0: acting now, or queued at the same instant).
Strings.glossary.heal.definition: Restores HP, never above the unit's maximum. A heal's strength scales with the healer's Special Attack.
Strings.glossary.knockback.definition: Pushes the unit a number of hexes straight away from the caster, stopping early at a blocked or occupied tile or the edge of the arena.
Strings.glossary.level_gap.definition: Hits between units of different levels are scaled by 1 + 0.05 x d + 0.045 x d x the size of d, where d is the attacker's level minus the target's, kept between x0.125 and x1.875. It works both ways: a team under its foes' level deals less and takes more, and a team 4 or more levels over its foes overwhelms them outright.
Strings.glossary.matchup_warnings.definition: Shown before every fight: no Vanguard or no Skirmisher in your picked team, an element disadvantage against this lineup, or being under-levelled. They are a heads-up, not a lock: you can still fight.
Strings.glossary.poison.definition: Damage over time from anything but fire: the unit loses a fixed amount of HP at the start of each of its turns while it lasts. Poison can stack.
Strings.glossary.ranged.definition: Keeps its distance: approaches only as far as its skills need, never walks into melee, and backs away from nearby enemies.
Strings.glossary.shield.definition: Soaks up damage before any HP is lost, for a few turns. Its strength is a share of the caster's Defense; a unit keeps only its strongest shield.
Strings.glossary.skirmisher.definition: Hit and run: closes in and strikes like a Vanguard, then spends any movement left retreating.
Strings.glossary.slow.definition: Lowers the unit's Speed for a few turns, so it acts less often.
Strings.glossary.stun.definition: A stunned unit loses its next turn: it cannot move or use skills, and its cooldowns do not count down. Being frozen or turned to stone is a stun.
Strings.glossary.taunt.definition: A taunted enemy must aim its single-target and line skills at the unit that taunted it, walking toward it if it is out of reach, until the taunt ends.
Strings.glossary.vanguard.definition: The front-line stance: walks straight in, stands between the enemy and its more fragile allies, and never retreats.
Strings.glossary.variance.definition: Every hit rolls a whole percent from 90% to 110% and is scaled by it, after the element and any crit, so the same hit lands a little differently each time.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_basilisk.text: It no longer looks away when you meet its eyes. That took a while.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_basilisk.title: Basilisk at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_frost_wyrm.text: Frost patterns bloom gently on the ground where it rests beside you.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_golem.text: Moss has started to soften its shoulders. It leans into a scratch like a boulder settling.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_golem.title: Golem at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_griffin.text: It brings you the shiniest pebble it can find and waits, very pleased with itself.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_griffin.title: Griffin at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_kirin.text: It leaves a faint trail of soft light on the grass wherever it has walked.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_kirin.title: Kirin at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_leviathan.text: It curls loosely by the water's edge now, unbothered when you sit close.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_leviathan.title: Leviathan at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_phoenix.text: It naps in the warmest patch of sun it can find, feathers banked low like embers.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_phoenix.title: Phoenix at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_tarasque.text: Its plates click together in a slow, contented rhythm when you visit.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_tarasque.title: Tarasque at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_thunderbird.tex: The air hums faintly when it is glad to see you, a small private thunder.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_treant.text: New leaves have budded along one arm. It holds very still so you can look.
Strings.grove_lore.affinity_lore_treant.title: Treant at Ease
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_hearth.text: A fed, played-with beast starts leaving little things by the gate, as if trading favours back.
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_hearth.title: Small Kindnesses
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_season.text: Some gifts only turn up after a beast has been settled in a good while. Patience, it seems, is its own reward.
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_season.title: What the Season Brings
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_wander.text: Every beast seems to bring something different when it is happy — a feather, a pebble, a leaf held very carefully.
Strings.grove_lore.gift_lore_wander.title: A Wandering Gift

Strings.habitat.snow_hollow.name: Snow Hollow
Strings.habitat.tide_pool.name: Tide Pool
Strings.hint.h_arts.text: You never strike. From behind the line your arts mend, shield and rally your team. Your badge sits at the foot of the board.
Strings.hint.h_arts.title: Your binder arts
Strings.hint.h_camp.text: Resting at camp trains one beast. Here the Keeper also brings your newer beasts up to your strongest one's level.
Strings.hint.h_camp.title: Camp
Strings.hint.h_consumable.text: The Keeper's Fury Draughts make your team hit harder for a few turns. Pick one below before a tough fight.
Strings.hint.h_consumable.title: Bring a draught
Strings.hint.h_crit.text: Big numbers are critical hits: lucky blows that land extra hard.
Strings.hint.h_crit.title: Critical hit!
Strings.hint.h_elements.text: One stingling hums with Nature. Fire burns Nature and Nature drinks Water: every element is strong against some and weak to others.
Strings.hint.h_elements.title: Elements
Strings.hint.h_finale.text: Something big and gloamed waits at the hedge. It is not wicked, only lost. Win, and the haze lets it go.
Strings.hint.h_finale.title: The Gloam
Strings.hint.h_idle.text: Your team keeps exploring when you rest. Tap the hourglass chip to collect what they found.
Strings.hint.h_idle.title: While you are away
Strings.hint.h_map_first.text: This is your home vale. The glowing place is where you can go next: tap it to see what waits there.
Strings.hint.h_map_first.title: Hearthglen
Strings.hint.h_obstacles.text: From here on the ground is rougher. Nobody can stand on a rock or a stump, but skills fly right over them.
Strings.hint.h_obstacles.title: Rocks and logs
Strings.hint.h_party.text: Tap a beast to bring it. Vanguards hold the front, Ranged beasts strike from the back, Skirmishers dart round the side.
Strings.hint.h_party.title: Your party
Strings.hint.h_pick_second.text: Your team grows one stance at a time: Vanguard, then Ranged, then Skirmisher. Some pairs share a Team Bond.
Strings.hint.h_pick_second.title: The next stance
Strings.hint.h_pick_third.text: One beast of each stance: from now on your team shares the Combined Arms bond in every fight.
Strings.hint.h_pick_third.title: A full team
Strings.hint.h_preview.text: Before every fight you see exactly who you will face: their kind, element and level, and the ground you will fight on.
Strings.hint.h_preview.title: Scout for free
Strings.hint.h_results.text: Every win pays XP, gold and materials. Fill the bar and your beast grows a level.
Strings.hint.h_results.title: After the fight
Strings.hint.h_skills.text: Your beasts pick their own skills. Each one rests for a few turns after use. Tap a skill below to read it.
Strings.hint.h_skills.title: Skills
Strings.hint.h_status.text: The little icons under a health bar are statuses, like a burn, a shield or a stun. They wear off after a few turns.
Strings.hint.h_status.title: Statuses
Strings.hint.h_trial.text: Win this trial and a new beast will choose to join you: one of the next stance, so your team grows well rounded.
Strings.hint.h_trial.title: A kinship stone
Strings.hint.h_turn_order.text: The bar at the top shows who acts next. Quick creatures act more often.

Strings.kinship.kin_r01.bond: Bond: win with a Vanguard holding the line.
Strings.kinship.kin_r01.intro: Wild beasts watch from the moss around the old stone. Show them how your team stands together, and one may choose to walk with you.
Strings.kinship.kin_r01.name: Mossbound Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r02.bond: Bond: win without a beast being knocked out.
Strings.kinship.kin_r02.intro: The stone glows like a coal as you come near. Something bright is watching from the ash, waiting to see what kind of team you are.
Strings.kinship.kin_r02.name: Cinderglow Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r03.bond: Bond: win with a Ranged beast in the team.
Strings.kinship.kin_r03.intro: The tide has just let the stone go. Something patient stirs in the pool beside it, curious about you.
Strings.kinship.kin_r03.name: Tidewrack Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r04.bond: Bond: win with a Skirmisher darting round the side.
Strings.kinship.kin_r04.intro: The wind howls everywhere but here. On the still stone, a pair of bright eyes is weighing you up.
Strings.kinship.kin_r04.name: Galecrest Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r05.bond: Bond: win without a beast being knocked out.
Strings.kinship.kin_r05.intro: Iron roots hold the stone like a hand. Something heavy and stubborn is dozing against it, one eye open.
Strings.kinship.kin_r05.name: Ironroot Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_rime.bond: Bond: win with a Vanguard holding the line.
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_rime.intro: The stone is clear as ice. Look into it and a beast looks back, then steps out of the snow to meet you.
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_rime.name: Rimeglass Stone
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_shade.bond: Bond: win without a beast being knocked out.
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_shade.intro: A dark stone drinks the snowlight. In its shadow, something sly and quiet has been waiting a long time for a friend.
Strings.kinship.kin_r06_shade.name: Deepshade Stone
Strings.line.forest_affinity_any_1.text: Your beast leans toward you now, just a little, when you are near. That is how it always starts.
Strings.line.forest_affinity_any_5.text: That bond is about as deep as they come. Whatever you did, keep doing it.
Strings.line.forest_decor_1.text: One little piece placed, and already the clearing feels less empty. Small things matter here.
Strings.line.forest_decor_5.text: Five pieces now. The wild things have started treating this place as part of the forest proper.
Strings.line.forest_default.text: The wild has its own quiet ways. Stay a while and you will learn to hear them.
Strings.line.forest_habitat_glade.text: The glade hums when it is happy. Can you hear it yet? Most cannot, at first.
Strings.line.forest_habitat_pool.text: The tide pool remembers every beast that has ever drunk from it. Odd, but true.
Strings.line.forest_habitat_snow.text: The snow hollow keeps its own kind of warmth, underneath. Dig a little and you will feel it.
Strings.line.forest_item_trinket.text: That bark from the hollow, press it flat and dry, and it keeps its shape for years.
Strings.line.forest_lore_found.text: That bloom you brought me carried more of a story than you knew. Glad it found its way to me.
Strings.line.forest_region_r01.text: The road behind you is calmer now. The wild things feel it too, in their own way.
Strings.line.gk_affinity_any_2.text: Whichever of your beasts has been keeping you company, it trusts you a little more than it did.
Strings.line.gk_affinity_any_4.text: That bond has grown deep. Some beasts start humming old tunes at that stage. Have you noticed?
Strings.line.gk_decor_3.text: You have started to make this place your own. A lantern here, a bench there, and it shows.
Strings.line.gk_decor_6.text: Six pieces placed with care, and the Grove already feels lived in. Beasts notice that more than you would think.
Strings.line.gk_habitat_glade.text: The mossy glade is yours now. Sit a while; the moss keeps the warmth of every beast that has rested here.
Strings.line.gk_habitat_pool.text: The tide pool breathes with the sea, even this far inland. Watch how the light moves across it at dusk.
Strings.line.gk_habitat_snow.text: The snow hollow never quite melts, and never quite freezes either. A patient sort of place.
Strings.line.gk_location_soothed.text: You calmed one of them with a gift instead of a fight. The Gloam lifts just as well for kindness as for courage.
Strings.line.gk_lore_found.text: That little tale a gift carried, I remember hearing it myself, long before you arrived.
Strings.line.gk_region_r01.text: Word travels fast from the wilds. I hear the first stretch of the road is calm behind you now.
Strings.line.gk_variety_15.text: Fifteen varieties pressed and catalogued. You could open a stall of your own at this rate.
Strings.line.gk_variety_5.text: Five varieties in the herbarium already. The Wildgarden rewards patience more than skill.
Strings.line.hg_camp_1.text: Rest here a while. The lanterns keep the haze at bay.
Strings.line.hg_camp_2.text: The miller says the Seals are only an old story. They are not. One sleeps in Verdant Hollow, just past the ridge.
Strings.line.hg_camp_3.text: Your newest friends are keen to keep up. Sit with them a while, and they will stand as tall as your first.
Strings.line.hg_farewell_1.text: You calmed it. See how the haze slipped off, and the creature wandered home, dazed but whole? That is your work now.
Strings.line.hg_farewell_2.text: Verdant Hollow starts past this ridge, and the Gloam is thicker there. Some places lie off the path: explore, and the map will fill in.
Strings.line.hg_farewell_3.text: When you need a quiet place, find me at the Grove. And listen for kinship stones in the wild: more beasts are waiting to meet you.
Strings.line.hg_shrine_1.text: There you are. I am the Grove Keeper; I have tended this shrine since before the old oak by the mill was an acorn.
Strings.line.hg_shrine_2.text: Your beast chose you. That is how every Beastbinder begins: not with a leash, but with a promise.
Strings.line.hg_shrine_3.text: Hold out your hand. There: a small mending light, your first binder art. You will never strike in a fight; you will keep your friends standing.
Strings.line.hg_shrine_4.text: Take these Fury Draughts, for when a fight turns against you. And go gently: the hedgerows are restless, and the Gloam's shimmer has reached the far hedge.
Strings.line.keeper_default.text: The wild remembers kindness. So do I.
Strings.line.scholar_affinity_species_phoenix.te: Your phoenix trusts you deeply now. Its plumage shifts a little at that stage, did you notice?
Strings.line.scholar_default.text: Every corner of this Grove is worth a footnote, if you look closely enough.
Strings.line.scholar_expedition_story.text: Frostglass Ridge again. Every party that returns from there brings back a slightly different account.
Strings.line.scholar_habitat_glade.text: A mossy glade. The moss itself is worth studying, it only grows where a beast has slept undisturbed.
Strings.line.scholar_habitat_pool.text: A tide pool this far from open water. I have three theories and no proof for any of them yet.
Strings.line.scholar_habitat_snow.text: A snow hollow that never fully thaws. My notes on it already run to four pages.
Strings.line.scholar_lore_grove.text: That story about the phoenix bond, I have heard three tellings, and yours matches the oldest one.
Strings.line.scholar_region_r01.text: The first stretch of road, quiet at last. I might finally survey it properly.
Strings.line.scholar_side_story_complete.text: My atlas of this Grove is complete, thanks to you. I could not have mapped it half so well alone.
Strings.line.scholar_variety_15.text: Fifteen varieties now. Your herbarium is becoming more thorough than my own field notes.
Strings.line.scholar_variety_30.text: Thirty varieties. I may need to ask you to review my next manuscript before I publish it.
Strings.line.scholar_variety_5.text: Five varieties catalogued. The cross pollination patterns alone could fill a chapter.
Strings.line.trader_affinity_any_3.text: That beast of yours watches you the way a good pack mule watches its favourite handler. Rare, that.
Strings.line.trader_default.text: Wares from every corner I have walked. Have a look, if coin or curiosity moves you.
Strings.line.trader_expedition_story.text: Whispering Hollow, was it. I have heard that story told three different ways by three different travellers.
Strings.line.trader_habitat_glade.text: A mossy glade for a home base, sensible. Easy to find, easy to defend, easy to sell to.
Strings.line.trader_habitat_pool.text: A tide pool habitat. I have seen beasts fetch salt glass from those on their own, given time.
Strings.line.trader_habitat_snow.text: A snow hollow keeps preserves fresher than any cellar I have paid for. Handy, that.
Strings.line.trader_item_dye.text: That sunwash dye in your pack, mixed well. Whoever crafted it has a good eye for warmth.
Strings.line.trader_lore_found.text: You heard the start of my old road story, then. There is more to it, when you have the time.
Strings.line.trader_region_r01.text: The road past the first stretch is quieter now, they tell me. Good for business, good for you.
Strings.line.trader_region_r02.text: Two stretches of road cleared. I might finally take the long route again myself.
Strings.line.trader_side_story_complete.text: You have heard the whole of my roads now, start to finish. Not many sit still long enough for that.
Strings.line.trader_variety_10.text: Ten varieties pressed already. I could move those at three markets before midday.
Strings.line.trader_variety_20.text: Twenty varieties now. You are outpacing half the growers I deal with on the road.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r01.text: Beasts of the Hollow come to this stone to decide who they will walk beside. It is soft with moss and warm to the touch, even at night.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r01.title: Mossbound Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r02.text: A stone as warm as bread from the oven. Beasts that bond here say its heat is the mountain blessing a good friendship.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r02.title: Cinderglow Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r03.text: Twice a day the sea covers this stone and twice a day it lets it go. Beasts that choose a binder here are patient ones: they have learned to wait for the tide.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r03.title: Tidewrack Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r04.text: The wind never touches this stone, however hard it blows around it. Beasts that meet their binder here say the calm was waiting just for them.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r04.title: Galecrest Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r05.text: Roots of iron have grown right around this stone and hold it like a hand. Bonds made here are said to be as hard to break as the roots themselves.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r05.title: Ironroot Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r06_rime.text: This stone is clear as glass and cold as the lake. Look into it and you see the beast who will choose you, looking back.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r06_rime.title: Rimeglass Stone
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r06_shade.text: A dark stone that drinks the snowlight. Beasts of shadow bond here in the long evenings, when the lake is quietest.
Strings.lore.lore_kin_r06_shade.title: Deepshade Stone
Strings.lore.lore_r01_firefly_road.text: Travellers once lit this path with jars of fireflies. The jars are long gone, but on warm nights the fireflies still come, as if they remember the way.
Strings.lore.lore_r01_firefly_road.title: Firefly Road
Strings.lore.lore_r01_first_binders.text: Moss has grown over the carving, but the shape is plain: a person and a beast side by side, each with a hand or a paw on the same stone. The first Beastbinders asked. They never commanded.
Strings.lore.lore_r01_first_binders.title: The First Binders
Strings.lore.lore_r01_humming_stones.text: Press an ear to the standing stones and you can hear them hum. The old songs say they hum louder whenever a beast and a binder trust each other nearby.
Strings.lore.lore_r01_humming_stones.title: Humming Stones
Strings.lore.lore_r01_warden_oath.text: Worn words under a mossy arch: "Keep the Seal, keep the peace." The Gloam has left the Warden keeping the first half and forgetting the second.
Strings.lore.lore_r01_warden_oath.title: The Warden Oath
Strings.lore.lore_r02_ash_gardens.text: Nothing should grow on these ridges, yet red flowers push up through the ash each spring. Villagers call them hearthbuds and leave one on every doorstep for luck.
Strings.lore.lore_r02_ash_gardens.title: The Ash Gardens
Strings.lore.lore_r02_cinder_sky.text: At dusk the rocks glow and the sky turns the colour of a banked fire. Old travellers said the mountain was dreaming, and walked softly so as not to wake it.
Strings.lore.lore_r02_cinder_sky.title: Cinder Sky
Strings.lore.lore_r02_kiln_road.text: Potters once carried their clay up here to fire it in the mountain breath. Shards of glazed cups still glitter in the path, bright as beetle wings.
Strings.lore.lore_r02_kiln_road.title: Kiln Road
Strings.lore.lore_r02_twin_flames.text: Two sparks, the story goes, leapt from the peak on the same night and never once burned apart. The Ember Twins still guard their Seal together, though the Gloam has made them forget why.
Strings.lore.lore_r02_twin_flames.title: The Twin Flames
Strings.lore.lore_r03_brine_charts.text: Scratched into the cave wall: a map of the currents, marked with little leaping fish. Whoever drew it knew the tides as well as their own heartbeat.
Strings.lore.lore_r03_brine_charts.title: Brine Charts
Strings.lore.lore_r03_colossus.text: The Colossus sat so long in the deepest pool that shellfish grew on its shoulders. The Gloam woke it, and it has been muddled and grumpy ever since.
Strings.lore.lore_r03_colossus.title: The Colossus Wakes
Strings.lore.lore_r03_drowned_bells.text: When the tide pours in, the bells of the sunken towers ring beneath the water. Divers say the sound is sweet, not sad: the towers were built to be drowned twice a day.
Strings.lore.lore_r03_drowned_bells.title: Drowned Bells
Strings.lore.lore_r03_frost_current.text: A cold stream runs in from the north and frosts the deepest pools. The creatures of Tidefall follow it like a road home.
Strings.lore.lore_r03_frost_current.title: The Frost Current
Strings.lore.lore_r04_cloud_line.text: Up here the clouds are the ground and the sky goes on forever. A binder journal, pinned under a stone: "Came to see the view. Stayed for the company."
Strings.lore.lore_r04_cloud_line.title: Above the Clouds
Strings.lore.lore_r04_gale_titan.text: The Titan once turned the winds so the crag folk could harvest. Now the Gloam makes it blow without stopping, and it cannot remember how to be still.
Strings.lore.lore_r04_gale_titan.title: The Gale Titan
Strings.lore.lore_r04_lost_kite.text: A child kite is tangled high on the crag, its tail snapping in the wind. Every traveller who passes adds a knot to keep it from blowing away.
Strings.lore.lore_r04_lost_kite.title: The Lost Kite
Strings.lore.lore_r04_nesting_cliffs.text: Griffins and thunderbirds share these cliffs the old way: griffins by day, thunderbirds by storm. Neither ever takes the other ledge.
Strings.lore.lore_r04_nesting_cliffs.title: The Nesting Cliffs
Strings.lore.lore_r04_rope_bridges.text: Every bridge here was tied by hand, knot by knot, by crag folk who sang to keep the rhythm. The wind still plucks them like harp strings.
Strings.lore.lore_r04_rope_bridges.title: Rope Bridges
Strings.lore.lore_r04_storm_eggs.text: Thunderbird eggs crackle softly in their nests, and the crag folk hum to them through every storm. A calm egg, they say, hatches a steady flyer.
Strings.lore.lore_r04_storm_eggs.title: Storm Eggs
Strings.lore.lore_r05_bell_trees.text: The iron trees ring when the wind moves them, each with its own note. A lost traveller can find the way out by following the lowest bells.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_bell_trees.title: The Bell Trees
Strings.lore.lore_r05_copper_path.text: Someone laid copper coins along the forest floor, one every few steps. Follow them and they lead, in a long slow loop, right back to where you started.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_copper_path.title: Copper Path
Strings.lore.lore_r05_iron_stags.text: The stags grow new antlers of ore every year and shed the old ones in the rain. Smiths once gathered them politely, leaving copper coins in thanks.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_iron_stags.title: The Iron Stags
Strings.lore.lore_r05_ore_seams.text: Bright seams of copper wind through the stones like threads of light. Tarasques guard the richest ones, not out of greed, but because they like to sleep on them.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_ore_seams.title: Ore Seams
Strings.lore.lore_r05_quiet_forge.text: An old forge stands cold among the iron trees. On rainy days the trees ring the very notes the hammers once made.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_quiet_forge.title: The Quiet Forge
Strings.lore.lore_r05_red_rain.text: When it rains in Rustwood the puddles run red and the air smells of pennies. The creatures love it: they roll in the rust like cats in sunshine.
Strings.lore.lore_r05_red_rain.title: Red Rain
Strings.lore.lore_r06_beneath.text: Deep under the ice something vast turns in its sleep, and the whole lake shivers. The old maps mark the spot with a single word: hush.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_beneath.title: Beneath the Lake
Strings.lore.lore_r06_ice_skaters.text: Snow folk children race across the frozen lake on bone skates, and the young frost wyrms race right beside them, grinning.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_ice_skaters.title: Ice Skaters
Strings.lore.lore_r06_last_light.text: On the longest night the lake glows faintly from below, as if the sleeper beneath it has lit a lamp to read by.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_last_light.title: The Last Light
Strings.lore.lore_r06_matriarch.text: The Frost Matriarch has watched over the lake for longer than anyone can count. The Gloam has made her fierce, but her young still gather at her feet.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_matriarch.title: The Matriarch
Strings.lore.lore_r06_pine_lanterns.text: Lanterns hang in the snowfield pines to guide travellers home. Someone still lights them each evening, though no one ever sees who.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_pine_lanterns.title: Pine Lanterns
Strings.lore.lore_r06_singing_ice.text: At night the frozen lake groans and chimes as it settles. The snow folk say it is the lake singing to whatever sleeps beneath it.
Strings.lore.lore_r06_singing_ice.title: The Singing Ice
Strings.material.essence_core.desc: The warm, gently pulsing heart of a great battle's essence. Feeds a skill a large amount of XP; opens its final breakthrough (level 15).
Strings.material.essence_core.name: Essence Core
Strings.material.essence_crystal.desc: A clear crystal of battle essence that chimes when tapped. Feeds a skill a good deal of XP; opens its second breakthrough (level 10).
Strings.material.essence_crystal.name: Essence Crystal
Strings.material.essence_shard.desc: A sliver of battle essence that glitters like frost. Feeds a skill a little XP; opens its first breakthrough (level 5).
Strings.material.essence_shard.name: Essence Shard

Strings.milestone.avatar_level_50.name: Veteran Binder (avatar level 50)
Strings.milestone.beast_level_100.name: Ascendant (beast level 100)
Strings.milestone.beast_level_25.name: Seasoned (beast level 25)

Strings.npc.forest_folk.name: Forest Folk
Strings.npc.grove_keeper.name: The Grove Keeper
Strings.npc.trader.name: The Trader
Strings.npc.wandering_scholar.name: The Wandering Scholar
Strings.npc_lore.forest_lore_bloom.text: The wild things bring dewgrass blooms to Forest Folk every season, and every season Forest Folk passes a few along to whoever seems to need one most.
Strings.npc_lore.forest_lore_bloom.title: A Seasonal Gift
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_1.text: Long before the habitats had names, the Grove Keeper planted a single seed here and waited three winters to see what it would become.
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_1.title: The First Root
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_2.text: The Keeper says a beast's trust is grown the same way a garden is, slowly, and never by pulling on it to make it faster.
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_2.title: A Question of Trust
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_3.text: Every dye the Wildgarden yields carries a little of the hand that mixed it, the Keeper claims to recognise a crafter by their sunwash alone.
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_3.title: Colour and Care
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_4.text: The Keeper believes a Grove remembers every visitor who ever tended it, long after the visitor has forgotten the visit.
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_roots_4.title: What the Grove Remembers
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_soil.text: The Grove Keeper tests ashbloom soil by scent alone, and claims to have never once been wrong about what grew there before the Grove did.
Strings.npc_lore.keeper_lore_soil.title: What the Soil Holds
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_1.text: The Scholar's notes on the snow hollow fill four pages and still end with the words more study needed.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_1.title: Mapping the Cold
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_2.text: Frostfern only opens where a chill lingers past its season, the Scholar suspects the snow hollow keeps its own private winter.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_2.title: A Bloom Out of Season
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_3.text: A frost rose, the Scholar explains, only forms where the ridge's wind crosses itself exactly right, proof, finally, of a theory chased for years.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_3.title: The Ridge Secret
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_4.text: With the first stretch of road surveyed, the Scholar's atlas gains its first fully finished page, dedicated, in small handwriting, to a patient companion.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_atlas_4.title: The Completed Page
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_colour_forms.text: The Wandering Scholar keeps a small book of pressed petals beside every dye vial, matching colour to colour until the pages run out.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_colour_forms.title: A Study in Dye
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_ice.text: The clear ice shard confirms it, Frostglass Ridge's ice forms in perfect layers, one season at a time, like the slowest journal in the world.
Strings.npc_lore.scholar_lore_ice.title: A Clear Answer
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_market.text: The Trader learned to spot a fair market from a rigged one by watching which stalls the local children lingered near.
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_market.title: Reading a Market
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_1.text: The Trader once tried to settle in a single town and lasted one season before the road called again, some people are built for moving.
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_1.title: Why I Walk
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_2.text: Duskrose dye fetches its best price three towns over, the Trader says, where the evenings run long and everyone wants a warmer colour to wear.
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_2.title: The Duskrose Trade
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_3.text: The Trader admits that clearing two stretches of road, the same as their own first journey, feels less like an ending and more like finally being caught up to.
Strings.npc_lore.trader_lore_roads_3.title: Two Stretches Down
Strings.passive.battle_hymn.desc: At the start of battle the Beastbinder's hymn quickens the team: +10% Speed for two turns.
Strings.passive.battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn
Strings.passive.bloodlust.desc: When an enemy is defeated, half the time the team surges: +10% Attack and Special Attack for two turns (at most once per Beastbinder turn).
Strings.passive.bloodlust.name: Rising Fervor
Strings.passive.iron_will.desc: Aura: the Beastbinder's steady presence gives every beast +5% Defense and Special Defense for the whole battle.
Strings.passive.iron_will.name: Iron Will
Strings.passive.keen_eye.desc: Aura: the Beastbinder's watchful eye gives every beast +5 crit chance for the whole battle.
Strings.passive.keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
Strings.passive.last_stand.desc: When a beast drops below 40% HP, the Beastbinder wraps it in a two-turn emergency shield (at most once every two Beastbinder turns).
Strings.passive.last_stand.name: Last Stand
Strings.passive.opening_ward.desc: At the start of battle the Beastbinder wards every beast with a two-turn shield worth part of the Beastbinder's Defense.
Strings.passive.opening_ward.name: Opening Ward
Strings.passive.storm_call.desc: When a beast lands a critical hit, the Beastbinder may call down a follow-up strike on every enemy (30% of the time).
Strings.passive.storm_call.name: Storm Call
Strings.passive.vengeance.desc: When a beast falls, the rest of the team steels itself: +15% Attack and Special Attack for three turns (twice a battle).
Strings.passive.vengeance.name: Kindred Resolve
Strings.passive.verdant_pulse.desc: Half the time a beast starts its turn, the bond mends a little of its HP.
Strings.passive.verdant_pulse.name: Verdant Pulse
Strings.passive.withering_curse.desc: At the start of battle the Beastbinder curses every enemy: -10% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
Strings.passive.withering_curse.name: Withering Curse
Strings.region.r00.desc: A sheltered vale below the tree line, where Verdant Hollow begins: warm hedgerows, an old mill, a shrine with a keeper who remembers the first Beastbinders. Only a faint shimmer at the far hedge says the Gloam is near.
Strings.region.r00.name: Hearthglen

Strings.region.r01.desc: A sun-dappled woodland of moss, ferns and old standing stones where every Beastbinder's journey begins. The Gloam is thin here, and the creatures it touches are more lost than fierce.
Strings.region.r01.name: Verdant Hollow
Strings.region.r02.desc: Ash-dusted ridges below a smouldering peak, where warm winds carry sparks and the rocks glow at dusk. Fire creatures bask on every ledge.
Strings.region.r02.name: Emberreach
Strings.region.r03.desc: Sea caves and drowned ruins where the tide pours in like a waterfall twice a day. Cold currents from the north bring frost to the deepest pools.
Strings.region.r03.name: Tidefall
Strings.region.r04.desc: Wind-cut crags above the cloud line, strung with rope bridges and nesting cliffs. The gales never stop, and neither do the creatures that ride them.
Strings.region.r04.name: Stormcrag
Strings.region.r05.desc: A forest of iron trees that rust red in the rain and ring like bells in the wind, rooted in stony ground rich with ore.
Strings.region.r05.name: Rustwood
Strings.region.r06.desc: A frozen lake as wide as a sea, ringed by snowfields and pine. The ice sings at night, and something vast sleeps beneath it.
Strings.region.r06.name: Frostmere
Strings.region.r07.desc: A forest of glassy spires that drink the lightning. The air hums, hair stands on end, and every storm leaves the rocks crackling.
Strings.region.r07.name: Thunderspire
Strings.region.r08.desc: The oldest, deepest forest, where trees grow as tall as towers and the undergrowth hums with life. Paths here move when no one is looking.
Strings.region.r08.name: Deepwild
Strings.region.r09.desc: The volcanic heart of the land: rivers of lava, fields of black glass and a molten throne at the summit, held by the Cinder King.
Strings.region.r09.name: Cinder Throne
Strings.region.r10.desc: The summit at the end of the Farwild, where fire and water pour from the same peak and the Gloam wells up between them. Only the strongest bonds reach it.
Strings.region.r10.name: Worldcrown
Strings.region.r11.desc: Beyond the Worldcrown the Gloam thins into an endless gold-and-violet evening, where radiant dawn and deep dusk share one sky. The eldest creatures of the Farwild gather here to test any bond whole enough to reach them.
Strings.region.r11.name: Duskmeridian
Strings.request.request_forest_bloom.text: A dewgrass bloom, freshly grown. The wild things ask for one every season, and I never say no.
Strings.request.request_keeper_variety.text: Two ashbloom blossoms, if the Wildgarden has spared them. I want to check something about this soil.
Strings.request.request_scholar_colour_form.text: Is that a duskrose phoenix I see? I would love an amber vial too, if you can spare one, to compare the dyes.
Strings.request.request_scholar_trinket.text: A clear ice shard from Frostglass Ridge would settle an argument I have been having with myself for years.
Strings.request.request_trader_dye.text: Bring me a vial of sunwash dye and I will tell you where I learned to spot a fair market from a rigged one.

Strings.scene.hg_farewell.title: Hollow's Edge

Strings.seal.seal_r01.desc: A moss-furred standing stone from the heart of Verdant Hollow. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r01.name: Moss Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r02.desc: A seal-stone that never quite cools, pried from the ridge of Emberreach. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r02.name: Ember Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r03.desc: A seal-stone crusted with shells, raised from the drowned ruins of Tidefall. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r03.name: Tide Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r04.desc: A seal-stone that whistles in the slightest breeze, taken from the crags of Stormcrag. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r04.name: Gale Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r05.desc: A seal-stone laced with iron that rings when touched, freed from the Rustwood. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r05.name: Iron Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r06.desc: A seal-stone rimed in frost that never melts, lifted from the ice of Frostmere. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r06.name: Rime Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r07.desc: A seal-stone that crackles with static, taken from the highest spire of Thunderspire. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r07.name: Thunder Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r08.desc: A seal-stone wrapped in living roots, drawn from the heart of the Deepwild. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
Strings.seal.seal_r08.name: Root Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r09.desc: A seal-stone of black volcanic glass, taken from the Cinder Throne. Claiming it lifts your binding limit to its peak.
Strings.seal.seal_r09.name: Cinder Seal
Strings.seal.seal_r10.desc: The last seal-stone, set where fire meets water on the Worldcrown. Your bond is already whole; claiming it stems the Gloam at its source.
Strings.seal.seal_r10.name: Crown Seal

Strings.shrine.shrine_r01_firefly.name: Firefly Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r01_firefly.text: Fireflies drift around a tiny lantern shrine. You take one glowing seed of the idea home with you.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r01_glade.name: Glade Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r01_glade.text: A little shrine of stacked stones, fresh flowers at its foot. Something of this glade will grow in your Grove one day.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r02_ember.name: Ember Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r02_ember.text: A brazier that has never gone out, tended by no one. Its warmth follows you a little way down the path.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r02_hearthbud.name: Hearthbud Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r02_hearthbud.text: Red hearthbuds bloom around a stone bowl of ash. One seed rolls into your hand as if it wanted to come.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r03_driftwood.name: Driftwood Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r03_driftwood.text: An arch of pale driftwood, smoothed by a hundred tides. The sea hums through it softly.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r03_pool.name: Tidepool Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r03_pool.text: A ring of shells around a still, clear pool. You could swear the water remembers your face.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r04_chimes.name: Chime Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r04_chimes.text: Chimes of bone and glass sing in the endless wind. Their tune stays in your head all day.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r04_thistle.name: Thistle Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r04_thistle.text: Thistles with heads like little clouds nod around a cairn. One puff drifts after you.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r05_bell.name: Bell Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r05_bell.text: An iron bell hangs from a rusted branch. It rings once as you pass, low and friendly.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r05_copper.name: Copper Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r05_copper.text: A sapling with copper leaves grows from a crack in the shrine stone. You pocket a single bright seed.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r06_hollow.name: Snow Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r06_hollow.text: A quiet hollow in the snow, sheltered and still. It feels like a place a beast would love to nap.
Strings.shrine.shrine_r06_lantern.name: Lantern Shrine
Strings.shrine.shrine_r06_lantern.text: A lantern carved from clear ice, glowing without a flame. You carry the shape of it home in your mind.
Strings.skill.absolute_zero.desc: Once a battle, the air itself freezes: every enemy is struck and may be frozen.
Strings.skill.absolute_zero.name: Absolute Zero
Strings.skill.aegis.desc: The Beastbinder throws a two-turn shield over every beast, worth part of the Beastbinder's Defense.
Strings.skill.aegis.name: Aegis
Strings.skill.bark_ward.desc: Grows a skin of bark over every ally within two hexes: a two-turn shield.
Strings.skill.bark_ward.name: Bark Ward
Strings.skill.battle_focus.desc: The Beastbinder calls out every opening: +8 crit chance for the whole team for three turns.
Strings.skill.battle_focus.name: Battle Focus
Strings.skill.blaze_bolt.desc: A concentrated lance of fire at up to four hexes.
Strings.skill.blaze_bolt.name: Blaze Bolt
Strings.skill.blessing.desc: Blesses the team: more Special Attack and Special Defense for two turns.
Strings.skill.blessing.name: Blessing
Strings.skill.blizzard.desc: Driving snow along all six axes, three hexes out.
Strings.skill.blizzard.name: Blizzard
Strings.skill.boulder_slam.desc: A ponderous stone fist on an adjacent foe: solid, dependable, never flashy.
Strings.skill.boulder_slam.name: Boulder Slam
Strings.skill.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning arcs between everything within two hexes, three times over: its answer to a swarm.
Strings.skill.chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Strings.skill.coup_de_grace.desc: Pounces on the most worn-down enemy in reach: up to +60% damage against a target that is nearly out of the fight.
Strings.skill.coup_de_grace.name: Shadow Pounce
Strings.skill.deep_freeze.desc: Encases the target in ice; it may be frozen solid for a turn.
Strings.skill.deep_freeze.name: Deep Freeze
Strings.skill.deep_shell.desc: Coils behind its scales and closes its wounds: a three-turn shield worth about two-thirds of its Defense and a small heal.
Strings.skill.deep_shell.name: Deep Shell
Strings.skill.eclipse_fang.desc: Four shadow bites in the blink of an eye: four crit rolls to find a weak point.
Strings.skill.eclipse_fang.name: Eclipse Fang
Strings.skill.ember_shot.desc: A bolt of flame that sets the target burning (stacks three times).
Strings.skill.ember_shot.name: Ember Shot
Strings.skill.entangling_roots.desc: Roots burst from the ground and may [[hold the target fast|Stun]] for a turn.
Strings.skill.entangling_roots.name: Entangling Roots
Strings.skill.firestorm.desc: Fire rains on every enemy and leaves them burning.
Strings.skill.firestorm.name: Firestorm
Strings.skill.flame_wave.desc: A sheet of fire down a four-hex line; may leave it burning.
Strings.skill.flame_wave.name: Flame Wave
Strings.skill.frost_breath.desc: A freezing exhalation over everything within two hexes; may chill (stacks three times).
Strings.skill.frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
Strings.skill.gale_talon.desc: A diving rake of talons on an adjacent foe.
Strings.skill.gale_talon.name: Gale Talon
Strings.skill.granite_bulwark.desc: Raises slabs of granite around itself and every ally within two hexes: a two-turn shield worth most of the Golem's Defense.
Strings.skill.granite_bulwark.name: Granite Bulwark
Strings.skill.gust.desc: A beat of great wings that [[hurls everything adjacent two hexes away|Knockback]].
Strings.skill.gust.name: Gust
Strings.skill.halo.desc: A ring of light heals and steadies every ally within two hexes.
Strings.skill.halo.name: Halo
Strings.skill.hex_of_frailty.desc: The Beastbinder hexes every enemy: -10% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
Strings.skill.hex_of_frailty.name: Hex of Frailty
Strings.skill.ice_armor.desc: Coats itself in rime: a shield and more Special Defense.
Strings.skill.ice_armor.name: Ice Armor
Strings.skill.iron_crush.desc: The Tarasque brings its whole plated weight down on one adjacent foe: its heaviest single blow.
Strings.skill.iron_crush.name: Iron Crush
Strings.skill.iron_fortress.desc: Braces behind its plates and waits for the counterblow: more Defense and Attack for three turns.
Strings.skill.iron_fortress.name: Iron Fortress
Strings.skill.judgment.desc: A pillar of light on one foe at up to four hexes: the Kirin's mightiest single strike.
Strings.skill.judgment.name: Judgment
Strings.skill.juggernaut_charge.desc: A two-hex charge that flattens the line and [[shoves the front of it back|Knockback]].
Strings.skill.juggernaut_charge.name: Juggernaut Charge
Strings.skill.lifebloom.desc: The whole team blossoms: a heal and a Defense boost.
Strings.skill.lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
Strings.skill.maelstrom.desc: A churning vortex around the Leviathan that wears down Special Defense.
Strings.skill.maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
Strings.skill.mending_light.desc: The Beastbinder raises a gentle light that heals every beast a little.
Strings.skill.mending_light.name: Mending Light
Strings.skill.miasma.desc: A cross of poison fog three hexes out that lingers and weakens.
Strings.skill.miasma.name: Miasma
Strings.skill.petrifying_gaze.desc: A glance that may [[turn the target to stone|Stun]] for a turn.
Strings.skill.petrifying_gaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
Strings.skill.plasma_barrage.desc: Four bolts down a four-hex line.
Strings.skill.plasma_barrage.name: Plasma Barrage
Strings.skill.predator_focus.desc: Locks its eyes on its target: +20 crit chance and more Special Attack for three turns.
Strings.skill.predator_focus.name: Predator Focus
Strings.skill.purifying_ward.desc: Wraps the whole team in pure light: a shield and more Special Defense for two turns.
Strings.skill.purifying_ward.name: Purifying Ward
Strings.skill.quake.desc: Stamps the ground: everything within two hexes is shaken and may be slowed.
Strings.skill.quake.name: Quake
Strings.skill.radiant_bolt.name: Radiant Bolt
Strings.skill.rallying_cry.desc: The Beastbinder's rallying cry: +10% Attack and Special Attack for the whole team for three turns.
Strings.skill.rallying_cry.name: Rallying Cry
Strings.skill.rebirth_flame.desc: Once a battle, the Phoenix wreathes itself in renewing fire: a heal and a large three-turn shield.
Strings.skill.rebirth_flame.name: Rebirth Flame
Strings.skill.rime_bolt.desc: A shard of ice that chills: -8% Speed for three turns, stacking up to three times.
Strings.skill.rime_bolt.name: Rime Bolt
Strings.skill.sacred_spring.desc: A spring of light wells up under the whole team and heals it.
Strings.skill.sacred_spring.name: Sacred Spring
Strings.skill.serpent_bite.desc: A crushing bite from the deep on an adjacent foe.
Strings.skill.serpent_bite.name: Serpent Bite
Strings.skill.shrapnel_burst.desc: Sheds a storm of metal scales at everything adjacent, and may crack their armour.
Strings.skill.shrapnel_burst.name: Shrapnel Burst
Strings.skill.sky_rend.desc: A plummeting strike that tears through armour.
Strings.skill.sky_rend.name: Sky Rend
Strings.skill.slowing_field.desc: The Beastbinder thickens the air around the enemy: -12% Speed for every enemy for three turns.
Strings.skill.slowing_field.name: Slowing Field
Strings.skill.spiked_carapace.desc: Bristles its spines: a shield and a Special Defense boost.
Strings.skill.spiked_carapace.name: Spiked Carapace
Strings.skill.spore_cloud.desc: Releases choking spores around itself: a lingering poison that also saps strength.
Strings.skill.spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
Strings.skill.static_charge.desc: Builds a charge in its feathers: +25 crit chance and more Speed for three turns.
Strings.skill.static_charge.name: Static Charge
Strings.skill.stone_challenge.desc: The Golem plants itself and bellows: enemies within three hexes may be taunted into attacking it for three turns.
Strings.skill.stone_challenge.name: Stone Challenge
Strings.skill.stoneskin.desc: Hardens its hide: +25% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
Strings.skill.stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
Strings.skill.storm_dive.desc: Opens the fight with a single dive from the clouds at up to three hexes: one heavy hit, once per battle.
Strings.skill.storm_dive.name: Storm Dive
Strings.skill.sunder.desc: A rending strike that cracks armour: -12% Defense for three turns, stacking up to three times.
Strings.skill.sunder.name: Sunder
Strings.skill.sunfire_nova.desc: A cross of white fire three hexes out along every axis that leaves its targets burning.
Strings.skill.sunfire_nova.name: Sunfire Nova
Strings.skill.tailwind.desc: Rides the wind: +20% Defense and Special Defense and one more hex of movement for two turns.
Strings.skill.tailwind.name: Tailwind
Strings.skill.tectonic_shove.desc: A shoulder charge that sends an adjacent foe [[skidding two hexes back|Knockback]].
Strings.skill.tectonic_shove.name: Tectonic Shove
Strings.skill.thorn_lash.desc: A whip of thorned vine at up to two hexes that leaves the target smarting with poison (stacks three times).
Strings.skill.thorn_lash.name: Thorn Lash
Strings.skill.thunder_talons.desc: Three quick bolts from its talons at the enemy with the least HP within two hexes: many light hits, each with its own crit roll.
Strings.skill.thunder_talons.name: Thunder Talons
Strings.skill.thunderclap.desc: A deafening crack around itself that may stun.
Strings.skill.thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
Strings.skill.tidal_renewal.desc: A cool tide washes over allies within two hexes, healing them and hardening their guard.
Strings.skill.tidal_renewal.name: Tidal Renewal
Strings.skill.tidal_wave.desc: A wall of water down a three-hex line that may [[knock the front rank back|Knockback]].
Strings.skill.tidal_wave.name: Tidal Wave
Strings.skill.undertow.desc: Churns the water into a whirlpool: enemies within three hexes are slowed and may be drawn to the Leviathan (taunted) for two turns.
Strings.skill.undertow.name: Undertow
Strings.skill.updraft.desc: Lifts the whole team on a rising wind: more Speed and one more hex of movement.
Strings.skill.updraft.name: Updraft
Strings.skill.venom_spit.desc: Spits a venom that keeps working (poison, stacks three times).
Strings.skill.venom_spit.name: Venom Spit
Strings.skill.verdant_mend.desc: Sap and leaf close the wounds of whichever ally within three hexes is worst off.
Strings.skill.verdant_mend.name: Verdant Mend
Strings.skill.wind_lance.desc: A spear of compressed air down a three-hex line.
Strings.skill.wind_lance.name: Wind Lance
Strings.story.keeper_roots.chapter.keeper_roots_: Sit with me a while. I want to tell you how this glade came to be the Grove's first root.
Bring me two sunpetal blooms, grown here and not bought elsewhere. I want to show you something about trust.
A vial of sunwash dye, if you have crafted one. The colour matters less to me than the making of it.
You have grown, gathered and given more than most who pass through here. That is the whole of the story, really.
Strings.story.keeper_roots.name: Roots of the Grove
Strings.story.scholar_atlas.chapter.scholar_atla: I am mapping every habitat in this Grove, in my own slow way. Would you help me start with the snow hollow?
A frostfern bloom for my notes, if the Wildgarden has one ready. I suspect it only grows where the hollow's chill reaches.
A frost rose from the ridge would confirm a theory I have been chasing for three seasons now.
With the road behind you quiet, I can finally cross reference my notes against what you have seen out there. Thank you for your patience.
Strings.story.scholar_atlas.name: The Wandering Atlas
Strings.story.trader_roads.chapter.trader_roads_: Settle in, and I will tell you how I ended up walking these roads instead of settling on one of them.
A vial of duskrose dye, if your Wildgarden has one to spare. It fetches a fair price where I am headed next.
Two stretches of road behind you now, same as me all those years ago. That is where this story ends, and a new one starts.
Strings.story.trader_roads.name: The Long Roads
